scope: Two fresh originalGUI/defaultQoS savedWalk processes in original interactive priority7 context; state diagnosis only, not a repairAB.
thread_requirement: All three native probes and original open/close records must use the same model threadTID; no cross-thread throughput comparison.
perturbation: About0.8sec per native checkpoint in previous state; delays modelready and close. Originalopen/close timed inside probes. Existing audit outer durations include probes and must be labelled accordingly. Do not use GUI latencies as unperturbed performance.

decision.rule: Both complete windows must show same-direction >=15% after-open/before-open throughput change to support an initialization-associated execution-state transition. Otherwise inconclusive or no large observed transition. Never inferGHz, temperature or sole cause.

remaining: Entry/controller/preflight integration and native stage ordering verification required before launch.
